standard_prerequisites.use: Gives the converse direction, applied after base change to Y'.

core_obligations: Forward direction: if f is universally open then each composite X_i -> Y is universally open, using that the covering maps are universally open and composition preserves the property (proof lines 7094-7100).
Converse direction: assume each f_i universally open and let Y' -> Y be arbitrary (proof lines 7101-7104).
Observe that the pulled-back family is again an fppf covering and that the pulled-back composites are open (proof lines 7104-7105).
Apply locality of openness on the source to conclude that the base change of f is open, hence that f is universally open (proof lines 7106-7107).
proof_roadmap: Converse direction via base change (proof lines 7101-7105).
Locality of openness and conclusion (proof lines 7106-7107).
difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that universal openness is fppf local on the source (statement lines 7084-7088). The proof shows both directions for an fppf covering {X_i -> X}: if f is universally open then so is each composite, because the covering maps are universally open and universal openness is preserved by composition; conversely, assuming each f_i universally open, one takes an arbitrary base change Y' -> Y, notes that the pulled-back family is again an fppf covering and that each pulled-back composite is open, and applies the corresponding locality lemma for openness to conclude that the base change of f is open, which is universal openness (proof lines 7090-7107). The level is H2: the argument is short but complete, with the reduction to the already-established openness statement made explicit.
